title: Add information on cabinet composition and elections to metadata. — addCabinetInfo
text: following columns added metaList: cabinet_name (ordered factor), cabinet_name_parlementcom, caretaker, cabinet_resigned (1 date formal resignation cabinet), term_start election_date. meaning caretaker depends source. ParlGov records caretaker spells separate cabinets, caretaker 1 . REPDEM one record per cabinet; caretaker status recorded per cabinet period (table cabinetPeriods), per vote (table voteCabinet) per question (table questionCabinet, response date). REPDEM data, caretaker 1 whenever cabinet caretaker (demissionair): resignation, election, interim cabinet. REPDEM data also get cabinet_id, cabinet_period_id, caretaker_reason caretaker_parlgov (ParlGov definition). votes questions, assignment voteCabinet questionCabinet used; votes questions missing table matched date.
